random_selection.selection: 30 lowest SHA256(seed + review_id) among all 1000 original IDs, without replacement

targeted_selection.selection_method: Exclude 30 random IDs. Select 10 highest absolute severity differences (tie SHA256(seed+ID)), then 10 intent differences (lowest hash), then 10 topic differences (lowest hash), without replacement. Purposeful cases; not representative.

checks: all six original field strings unchanged

random.interpretation: AI-assisted qualitative judgments; not human gold or measured accuracy

targeted.interpretation: AI-assisted qualitative judgments; not human gold or measured accuracy

classification_signals.interpretation: needs_review is a prediction from model ambiguity flags and/or deterministic checks; it is not a calibrated probability of error. Missing provider confidence remains unknown.

limitations: Independent model agreement is not human accuracy.
Initial model agreement uses saved pre-fallback predictions; final agreement includes routed fallback answers.
A fallback sharing the verifier's model can have correlated errors; agreement gains are not proof of correctness.
Targeted difficult cases must be reported separately from the seeded random sample.

fallback_analysis.interpretation: Fallback and verifier both use gpt-oss-120b. Agreement gains can share model errors and do not measure accuracy.

semantic_concerns.finding: Top usability evidence describes app crashes/no sound/audio quality, which the rubric assigns to playback. The memo accurately repeats saved labels but inherits category contamination.
Premium-linked music-selection restrictions are billing under the frozen rubric, and restricted controls do not establish total playback blockage.

The assertion that downloads have the smallest volume among actionable topics depends on an undefined exclusion: support has one complaint versus nine downloads. Replace the superlative or define actionable in a future memo.

memo_checks.interpretation: Numeric traceability passes conditional on model labels. The substantive priority recommendation remains provisional pending classification repairs and human evaluation.

gate.confidence: high that material rubric violations remain; unknown human benchmark accuracy
gate.rationale: Random inspection found seven concerns, six unflagged. The existing ambiguity flag plus capped fallback does not catch observed errors. The verifier also makes mistakes.
next_actions: Correct or clarify existing rubric boundaries in a separately versioned development configuration.
Test the saved failure cases and a fresh seeded development sample; preserve all earlier outputs.
If prompts/settings change, repeat the supplied cold/warm 100 checkpoint with a new cache namespace.
Measure candidate models/routing on source-only inputs; do not assume blind verifier labels are true.
Evaluate the isolated golden 50 only after the user supplies human labels; never use them for tuning.
Reassess the 10,000 checkpoint and 210,000 expansion only after quality, budget, throughput and deployment gates are supported.

limitations: The random 30 and purposeful targeted 30 have different selection mechanisms and are not pooled into a population error rate.
Assessments were made by AI agents using original review text and the rubric; no independent human correctness labels were created.
Ambiguous is distinct from wrong; it records interpretations needing adjudication or missing context.
Quote containment and literal entities establish source integrity, not semantic support or entity recall.
No model confidence probability was supplied or calibrated. needs_review remains an uncalibrated model/deterministic flag.
No runtime labels, recommendations, model configurations or paid requests were modified by this inspection.
